title: Enrichment Operation Start Permission Consistency

items.action: start customer contact enrichment through an Operation

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.scraper.execute permission is reused.

audit.reason: Existing operation create/start audit behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: Route-level operation wizard cleanup is intentionally handled separately.

notes: Enrichment Start is one user-triggered business action. The existing frontend execution boundary and direct enrichment API already use fair_crm.scraper.execute. For start_immediately enrichment requests, Operation creation and Operation start are orchestration only and must not add fair_crm.operations.create or fair_crm.operations.execute prerequisites. Non-immediate creation, Retry, Scraper Wizard, and route guards remain out of scope.
